mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate directly reduces the cost of capital for corporations, increasing equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in >60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 4.0% and the Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and returns is < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A month-over-month increase in housing starts exceeding 1.5% indicates robust consumer demand and economic expansion, leading to higher corporate earnings expectations and positive S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in >60% of periods when HOUST rises >1.5% month-over-month and the Rank IC between HOUST and returns is < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and employment (PAYEMS) above their respective 3-month moving averages signals strong economic momentum, boosting corporate profits and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in >60% of periods when both HOUST and PAYEMS rise above their 3-month moving averages and the Rank IC for the interaction is < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 5.5%), the risk of economic contraction increases, leading to reduced corporate investment and lower S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in >60% of periods when UNRATE > 5.5% and the Rank IC between UNRATE and returns is > -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) reflects robust manufacturing activity and economic growth, leading to higher corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in >60% of periods when INDPRO is rising and the Rank IC between INDPRO and returns is < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the federal funds rate exceeding 0.5% indicates an active monetary tightening cycle, increasing borrowing costs and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns within 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of periods when FEDFUNDS rises >0.5% in 3 months and the Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and returns is > 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in industrial production (INDPRO) and stable or declining federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals a strong economy with supportive monetary policy, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in >60% of periods when INDPRO rises and FEDFUNDS falls and the Rank IC for the interaction is < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes (GDPC1 growth exceeding 3.0% annualized), the economy is operating near capacity, driving strong corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in >60% of periods when GDPC1 growth > 3.0% annualized and the Rank IC between GDPC1 growth and returns is < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
